description: Frozen reference panel of benchmark difficulties from v0.32.0 baseline + banked runs (M-EVAL-ROLLING-ELO M1). Discriminating-band benchmarks spanning core to frontier tiers. When fitting ratings, these benchmark difficulties are held fixed to anchor the ELO scale, making ratings comparable across pool compositions.
corpus: v0.32.0 baseline standard + subsequent banked runs
notes: This anchor is versioned and committed; re-anchoring is an explicit, versioned event (never silent). When new benchmarks are added to the suite, they enter at DefaultInitialRating (1500) and are not anchored until an explicit re-anchor release. Placement fit holds these benchmark difficulties fixed; direction fit holds model strengths fixed.
